_note: Batch 3 config. Finds EARLY-STAGE FOUNDERS on LinkedIn via Apify actor harvestapi/linkedin-post-search (cookieless, no LinkedIn account, zero ban risk). Forked from clienthunt/sources/intent_config.json and retuned end to end for wrrk.ai. The actor returns each post's author name AND author LinkedIn URL, which is the whole point here: batch 1 and 2 had no reliable LinkedIn profiles, so this pool is messageable from the moment it lands.
_thesis: Two buckets. 'ask' = a founder explicitly asking which CRM/inbox/WhatsApp tool to use, rare and gold, reply within hours. 'early' = a founder whose post proves the company is young (just launched, first hire, pre-seed, small team). Early stage matters because there is no incumbent stack to rip out, so switching cost is zero, which is the entire reason a 2-person company will try a new workspace and a 200-person one will not.

apify._cost: ~$0.24 per full run (10 queries x 20 posts). FREE plan gives $5/month.

linkedin_queries_ask: looking for a CRM for our startup
need a shared inbox for our team
how do you manage WhatsApp enquiries
we are managing leads in a spreadsheet
recommendations for a small business CRM
too many tools for our small team
twitter_queries: which crm should i use startup
need a shared inbox for support
just launched my startup first customers
promo_phrases: we are hiring for our client
_vendor_authors_note: CRM and WhatsApp vendors post about CRM constantly and are the single biggest noise source in this pool. intent_linkedin.py drops them by author name AND by promo phrase.
